name: RemoveOutliersNode
label: Remove Outliers
description: Removes rows whose value in a numeric column is flagged as an outlier using the IQR or Z-score method. Computed per optional group columns.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the numeric column to analyze.

fields.name: ValueColumn
fields.label: Value Column
fields.description: The numeric column used to determine outliers.

fields.name: Method
fields.label: Method
fields.description: The detection method: 'IQR' or 'ZScore'. Defaults to 'IQR'.

selectOptions.label: IQR
selectOptions.description: Uses the interquartile range with a configurable multiplier.

selectOptions.label: ZScore
selectOptions.description: Uses the Z-score with a configurable cutoff.

fields.name: Threshold
fields.label: Threshold
fields.description: The IQR multiplier (e.g. 1.5) or Z-score cutoff (e.g. 3) depending on method. Defaults to 1.5.

fields.name: GroupByColumns
fields.label: Group By Columns
fields.description: Optional comma-separated columns to compute outlier statistics within. Leave empty to use the whole table.

fields.name: CleanedDataTable
fields.label: Cleaned Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with outlier rows removed.
